formal_object.rationale: Two explicit local terminal perturbations define Jacobians, self Hessians and a mixed Hessian.

operations_and_conditions.rationale: C05: Include mixed Hessian, not only propagated single errors. Condition: F has bounded appropriate third derivatives in the visited neighborhood C04: Separate pair interaction from additive single effects. Condition: Identical trajectory/randomness and complete probe cost

derivation.rationale: Multivariate Taylor includes self and mixed terms; coupled single/pair contrast isolates the local mixed term and retains O(||eta||^3).

assumptions.rationale: A smooth local expansion must remain valid on actual sampled trajectories. Probe randomness is coupled and fixed for comparisons; all extra forward/probe evaluations count. No accepted second-order cache planner or full native quality/resource frontier currently exists. These are conditional premises, not observed benchmark facts.

method_expression.rationale: No finite accepted probe/caching planner or amortized native quality/resource contract exists; O(s^2) probes can negate all savings.

prediction_and_falsifier.rationale: Mixed effects must be large enough and sufficiently stable across actual repeated reuse to justify the complete cost; this cannot be inferred from one mathematical cross term. Falsification: Linear propagation or simple caching matches the full frontier, or pair-probe costs exceed savings and/or degrade motion/quality.

closest_alternative.rationale: RA-CFGCache and linear propagation remain relevant; second-order diagnostic algebra alone does not establish a distinct, practical cache policy.
